title: GATE testing and grooming by outside psychologists

tellings.quote: So, basically in 2004 2005, um I was tested by gifted and talented education. People may have heard the gate or the tag claims. Um I was tested with what was the Woodcock test of achievement.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose says that in 2004 or 2005, as a child in Springville, New York, he was tested by a gifted and talented education programme, sometimes called GATE or TAG. He says they gave him the Woodcock test of achievement, a standard school achievement test, and he ties this to outside psychologists picking him out and grooming him. Jose tells it as his own experience, in an interview about being taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, which he presents as the start of that story.
